parameters.text: It’s still early and, like usual, you’re out on the school yard. As expected, Billie is causing a commotion on the other side of the yard, as she does everyday. She seems to be harassing Vic again. It’s been going on for so long that it’s practically part of the routine at this point, the occurrence barely registering in your brain. But this time Vic raises their voice at Billie in an attempt to stand up for themselves, something about this makes the situation feel more real, like you have a say in how it ends.
